verdict.rationale: Trello's own site lists an "MCP server" that will "Connect Trello to any AI tool," so it claims a first-party MCP server. That claim is a single marketing line with no setup, tool list, auth or transport documentation and no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: setup/connection documentation, list of exposed MCP tools/resources, authentication and scope details, supported clients/transport, independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: MCP server Connect Trello to any AI tool
